definitions.explanation: The industry and practice of processing raw fish and other marine products into preserved, prepared, or packaged food items. Includes smoking, drying, canning, and freezing of seafood.

examples.english: This town thrives on seafood processing.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{水産|すいさん}→水産：04290_suisan⟧ (marine products, fishery) and ⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧ (processing). Japan's extensive coastline and fishing tradition make seafood processing a significant industry, particularly in northern regions like Hokkaido and the Sanriku coast.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水産|すいさん}{加工|かこう}{品|ひん}: processed seafood products
- {水産|すいさん}{加工|かこう}{業|ぎょう}: seafood processing industry
- {水産|すいさん}{加工|かこう}⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧: seafood processing plant
- {水産|すいさん}{加工|かこう}⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧: seafood processing company

PRODUCT EXAMPLES:
- ⟦{干物|ひもの}→干物：12423_himono⟧: dried fish
- {蒲鉾|かまぼこ}: fish cake
- ⟦{缶詰|かんづめ}→缶詰：00187_kanzume⟧: canned seafood
- ⟦{塩辛|しおから}→塩辛：08228_shiokara⟧: salted and fermented seafood
- {練|ね}り⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: surimi products

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{水産業|すいさんぎょう}→水産業：15919_suisangyou⟧: fishery industry — the broader fishing and aquaculture sector
- ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦{加工|かこう}→加工：11793_kakou⟧: food processing — a broader category not limited to seafood
